command: Return exactly CODEX_K1_OK and do not use tools.
capture.stdin: closed (</dev/null). Without this the command blocks on 'Reading additional input from stdin...' and never terminates.

live.capture_note: Captured with the same command minus --ephemeral, which is required because --ephemeral persists no rollout file.

why_this_version_exists: The 0.146.0 fixture set was captured on 2026-08-02. On 2026-08-12 the host runtime was upgraded to 0.147.0 to clear an interactive 'Update available' startup interstitial that prevented Codex from opening a thread, which made bare `xt codex` unusable (bead xtrm-7edzx).
That upgrade left the K1 fixtures pinned to a runtime no longer installed, so the K4 parity matrix would have certified parity against a version nobody runs. This set restores that provenance.
Result: the hook payload contract is unchanged. See manifest.json 'compatibility' for the verified per-surface comparison.
notes: The 0.146.0 capture emitted an extra item.completed advisory about the skill context budget. That advisory is environment-dependent, not version-dependent: it was observed on 0.147.0 in an interactive session during the same work. Its absence here is not a regression.
The fixture records event shape, not a promise that every successful run emits the same advisory items.
